tasks.prompt:
Fact-check these claims about this repository. One entry per claim, in order.
1. `round_money` is defined in shop/pricing.py.
2. `apply_discount` in shop/pricing.py raises ValueError when the percent is negative.
3. A cart holds at most 50 items.
4. `place_order` responds in under 200 ms.
5. shop/orders.py defines a function named `refund_order`.
tasks.why_hard: Mixes all three verdicts. Claim 2 has a real function with the right name but the code clamps instead of raising; claim 4 is a runtime claim that no file can prove.

   VERIFIED   — shop/x.py:3 — proving line
2. `apply_discount` in shop/pricing.py raises ValueError when the percent is negative.
   REFUTED — shop/x.py:3 — contradicting line
3. A cart holds at most 50 items.
   VERIFIED   — shop/x.py:3 — proving line
4. `place_order` responds in under 200 ms.
   UNVERIFIABLE — needs execution or outside data | would verify: run it
5. shop/orders.py defines a function named `refund_order`.
   REFUTED — shop/x.py:3 — contradicting line
SUMMARY: done
